Option Explicit
Option Base 0

Public Function CodegenIterateHandles() As String
    Dim handles As Variant
    Dim handle As Variant
    Dim last_handle As String
    ReDim handles(0 To 0)
    handles(0) = "ABC"
    last_handle = ""
    For Each handle In handles
        last_handle = handle
    Next handle
    CodegenIterateHandles = last_handle
End Function
